detail: Viyash Scientific Limited has made acquisition of 100% shareholding of BioForLife Italia S.r.l, a pet-care company based in Milan, Italy, for ~₹188 crore. DSK Legal advised Viyash Scientific and Alivira Animal Health Limited, Ireland, a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of Viyash, on this acquisition. The Firm advised inter alia , in the structuring of Transaction and relevant acquiring entity from the group structure of Viyash; drafting, review, negotiating and finalizing the share purchase agreement (SPA) and other ancillary agreements; attending in-person negotiation with the sellers to represent Viyash / Alivira in Milan, Italy; general advisory in relation to the Transaction and…
